facts.text: RepoFile walks parent directories from AppContext.BaseDirectory and throws FileNotFoundException when the relative path is not found.
Doc loads each contract file once and caches it in the static Documents dictionary that uses StringComparer.Ordinal.
The validator throws NotSupportedException for a keyword outside the Annotations set, naming the keyword and the schema file.
Validate throws NotSupportedException when a schema node is not a JSON object, because the contracts use no boolean schemas.
at: boolean schemas are not used by the contracts

facts.text: The oneOf handler records an error when the instance does not match exactly one branch, and appends each failing branch's errors.
Resolve splits a reference at the first hash, keeps the file part, and walks the pointer segments through the loaded document.
TypeMatches counts a JSON number as integer only when TryGetInt64 succeeds on it.
ErrorsAgainstDefinition validates an instance against one named entry of a contract's $defs, for shape-set files such as ops.schema.json.
Schemas_AcceptEmittedLinesAndManifest demands the record types fact and subject in mode none, and adds asset for embed and files.
AssertBundleValid throws on the first record that fails jsonl-record.schema.json, requires at least one record, then requires a manifest with no errors.
Schemas_AcceptMissingAssetAndScopedSubjectWithoutParent deletes the blob, then requires a record carrying missing and a subject record without parent.
Schemas_AcceptManifestWithProfileOptions requires the manifest options to contain profile and the manifest to validate when RespectLimits is set.
Schemas_RejectMalformedRecords asserts a fact record whose confidence is 1.5 fails jsonl-record.schema.json.
A hand-built asset record whose path is ../assets/a.png is rejected by jsonl-record.schema.json.
A manifest whose format is dossier-jsonl/2 is rejected by jsonl-manifest.schema.json.
Schemas_ParseAndTrackTheBaseContracts requires the record schema to expose 3 oneOf branches and the listed $defs names.
SubjectRecord's properties and required lists equal subject.schema.json's lists plus path and type.
FactRecord's properties and required lists equal fact.schema.json's lists plus bundle_key, subject_name and type.
Every inherited property in SubjectRecord and FactRecord must reference the base contract's property of the same name.
AssetEmbedded, AssetFile and AssetMissing each set additionalProperties to the JSON false value.
The manifest schema pins format to the const dossier-jsonl/1 and sets additionalProperties to false.
AssetMissing requires bytes, filename, mime, missing, sha256 and type.
The manifest schema requires assets, bundle_hash, counts, file_stats, files, format and options.
A manifest with the bundle_hash property removed is rejected by jsonl-manifest.schema.json.
RequireUnix skips every hardening test on Windows because named pipes and /dev/zero symlinks are Unix-only.
at: named pipes and /dev/zero symlinks are Unix-only

facts.text: Mkfifo starts the external mkfifo process and throws InvalidOperationException when that process exits nonzero.
ImportFails runs the import on a background task and throws TimeoutException when it has not returned within 5 seconds.
Tamper rewrites dossier-0001.jsonl and updates its file_stats entry with the new bytes, line count and sha256.
Import_FifoManifestFailsFast replaces manifest.json with a FIFO and expects ImportFails to return code import_not_regular_file.
Import_FifoDataFileFailsFast turns dossier-0001.jsonl into a FIFO and expects import_not_regular_file with 0 rows left in the facts table.
Import_ManifestSymlinkedToDevZeroFailsFast links manifest.json to /dev/zero and expects code import_unsafe_path.
Import_FifoAssetFileIsSkippedNotRead expects Blobs to be 0 and the single skipped reason to mention regular file.
Import_SymlinkedManifestIsRejected moves the manifest out and links it back, expecting import_unsafe_path and 0 facts.
Import_SymlinkedAssetsDirectoryIsNotFollowed expects Blobs to be 0 and the skipped reason to mention symbolic link.
Import_SymlinkedAssetsDirectoryIsNotFollowed also requires the destination BlobRoot to hold no entries at all.
Import_EmbeddedDataWithJsonEscapesIsSkipped rewrites the first base64 character as a JSON escape and expects a skipped reason containing escapes.
Import_DataFileNumberThatOverflowsIsABadManifest adds dossier-99999999999999999999.jsonl and expects import_bad_manifest.
Import_DuplicateNamesInManifestFilesAreABadManifest adds dossier-0001.jsonl to files twice, expecting import_bad_manifest and 0 facts.
Import_EmbeddedBlobLandsWithoutTemporaryFiles expects Blobs of 1 and exactly one entry in BlobRoot named after the sha.
Import_UnlistedFileUnderAssetsIsRejected writes a stray 64 character png under assets and expects import_unlisted_file.
Import_DuplicateAssetRecordsMustAgree accepts an identical duplicate asset line and reports Blobs of 1.
A duplicate asset line with image/jpeg in place of image/png is rejected as import_bad_record whose message contains the sha.
Publish_FileBeyondTheMemoryCeilingFailsClosed sets MemoryCeilingBytes to 400 and expects bundle_too_large_for_memory with no output directory.
Publish_EmbeddedAssetBeyondTheMemoryCeilingFailsClosed sets an embed ceiling of 40 and expects bundle_too_large_for_memory with nothing written.
Republish_FailingALimitLeavesEveryOldFileUntouched expects a MaxFileBytes of 50 to fail with a message containing nothing was written.
Republish_FailingALimitLeavesEveryOldFileUntouched also compares every file present before the failed publish for byte equality afterwards.
Import_EmbeddedBlobLandsWithoutTemporaryFiles also compares the stored blob bytes with the seeded bytes.
Link creates a symbolic link and calls Skip.Test when Windows refuses it with UnauthorizedAccessException or IOException.
Published seeds the database, publishes with the given assets mode and returns the output directory.
EditManifest parses manifest.json, applies the edit and writes it back encoded with Jsonl.Utf8.
FactCount opens a connection and counts the rows of the facts table with a scalar query.
The Md helper publishes with assets no override, a fixed 2026 clock and the command line dossier publish --out out.
Republish_LeavesIdenticalBytesAlone expects the first publish to write something and the second to write 0 files.
Republish_LeavesIdenticalBytesAlone also requires dossier-0001.jsonl to keep its last write timestamp and zero removals.
Prune_MarkdownThenJsonlRemovesMarkdownFilesAndKeepsForeignOnes keeps notes.txt while deleting every markdown file and the subjects directory.
Prune_MarkdownThenJsonlRemovesMarkdownFilesAndKeepsForeignOnes expects more than 5 removals and a rewritten manifest with format dossier-jsonl/1.
Prune_JsonlThenMarkdownRemovesDataFilesAndAssetsAndEmptyDirectories records the data file and assets/sha png in Removed and leaves no assets directory.
After the markdown publish the manifest format reads as the integer 1, unlike the republish test that compares the string.
Prune_JsonlRepublishWithFewerFilesRemovesTheExtraOnes publishes with MaxFileBytes 1400 then with assets none, expecting a single data file.
The second publish removes dossier-0002.jsonl and the asset png, as Prune_JsonlRepublishWithFewerFilesRemovesTheExtraOnes asserts by name.
Foreign_DataFileWithDifferentBytesIsRefusedAndNothingIsWritten expects publish_conflict and leaves the foreign dossier-0001.jsonl bytes untouched.
Foreign_DataFileWithDifferentBytesIsRefusedAndNothingIsWritten also requires that no manifest.json or assets directory appears.
Foreign_AssetFileWithDifferentBytesIsRefused expects publish_conflict naming the assets png and no dossier-0001.jsonl written.
After Foreign_AssetFileWithDifferentBytesIsRefused writes the real blob bytes over the asset, a repeat publish succeeds without error.
Foreign_UnlistedLookalikeIsNeitherOverwrittenNorPruned expects dossier-0009.jsonl, absent from the previous manifest, to keep the text mine.
Manifest_ExistingManifestIsOverwrittenAndTraversalEntriesAreNeverDeleted lists ../victim.txt, /etc/hosts and assets/ZZ.png and leaves victim.txt holding keep.
Manifest_ExistingManifestIsOverwrittenAndTraversalEntriesAreNeverDeleted then requires the manifest to be replaced with format dossier-jsonl/1.
WriteBundle_DoesNotDecodeDataFilesAsText prepends the three UTF-8 BOM bytes to a generated data file and expects publish_conflict.
